title: The Quantum Gardener
body: An astrophysicist discovers that her grandmother's greenhouse is a portal into parallel universes and must choose which reality to preserve.

title: Paper Moons
body: Two elderly origami artists reunite decades after a public feud and find that their best work has been in the folds of each other's silences.

title: Red Line Ruby
body: A disgraced subway conductor pulls a double shift on the last train of the year and picks up passengers who aren't supposed to exist.

title: The Accidental Cartographer
body: A GPS glitch sends a delivery driver through streets that no longer exist, drawing a map of a city that was demolished forty years ago.

title: Soft Engines
body: In a near-future where emotions are taxed, a black-market therapist runs an illegal grief clinic out of an abandoned laundromat.

title: Catfish Heirloom
body: A family of catfish farmers in the Mississippi Delta inherits a 19th-century ledger that reveals their land was once something else entirely.

title: Helios Complaint
body: The sun files a union grievance. A retired mythologist is appointed arbitrator.

title: North of Seventeen
body: A cartographer and a radio DJ chase a signal that only appears above the 17th parallel, through ice storms and forgotten languages.

title: The Spoon Collector of Prague
body: A lonely archivist catalogs the personal spoons of Cold War defectors and discovers a coded history no one meant to write.

title: Meridian Bloom
body: A botanist at a quiet research station begins receiving letters from a version of herself who took a different turn in 1997.

title: Last Lamp Before the Bridge
body: Three rival night-shift lighthouse keepers race to save a ship that may be a ghost in the fog off the Washington coast.

title: The Bread Testament
body: When a beloved baker dies, her recipes become a contested inheritance between six towns that each claim she was from there.

title: Weightless in Lagos
body: A teenage free-diver discovers a pressurized bubble of air trapped since the 1800s off the Nigerian coast and must decide who gets to open it.

title: Offline Bride
body: A wedding planner accepts a commission in a village that has never had internet, and must stage a ceremony without a single digital trace.

title: Statistical Animals
body: A data scientist in the Serengeti realizes the elephants are watching her spreadsheets.

title: The Dust Orchestra
body: In a drought-stricken prairie town, a retired music teacher builds instruments out of abandoned grain silos and accidentally wakes something ancient.

title: Four Weather Stations
body: Four meteorologists spread across four continents share one chaotic radio frequency and an inexplicable shared dream.

title: Kelp Mail
body: A postal carrier in Monterey starts receiving letters that were written but never sent — delivered by the ocean itself.

title: The Warehouse of Impossible Keys
body: An insurance appraiser inventories a Detroit warehouse full of keys that don't match any lock — until one of them does.

title: Concrete Harp
body: A demolition crew hears a piece of music that can only be played by collapsing a specific building, composed by a long-dead architect.
